scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Divyangjan Vivah Protsahan Anudan Yojana
other_conditions: At least one individual in the couple must have a disability
Minimum age requirement: bride must be at least 18 years old and groom at least 21 years old at the time of marriage
Both bride and groom should belong to poor families
benefits_summary: Provides a ₹1,00,000 grant to disabled individuals in a marriage, with additional units if both spouses are disabled or if the marriage is inter‑caste.
